scope: Only attached live appends are checked. Detached seed/restore replay is unchanged.
The immutable candidate is checked after internal dispatch and callback filter/bind, immediately before log.push.
The admission is one store-owned synchronous closure. Post-commit observers retain official exception containment.
Unmodified rc.2 pre-append listeners cannot detect a later non-throwing dispatch listener invalidating a lease; the existing native-input-access test preserves that control.
This extension supplies a final check, not asynchronous producer admission or entitlement policy.
